recipe.kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day
recipe.title: Queen of Puddings
recipe.meta: Serves four. Preparation, twenty minutes; baking, forty minutes.
body: **Base:** ½ pint milk, 2 oz fresh breadcrumbs, 1 oz butter, the grated rind of a lemon, 2 oz sugar, 2 egg yolks.
**Top:** 2 egg whites, 2 oz caster sugar, a little warmed raspberry jam.

Warm the milk with the butter, rind and sugar, pour over the crumbs and let stand. Stir in the yolks, turn into a buttered dish and bake until set. Spread with jam, pile the stiffly whisked whites and sugar over, and return to a cool oven until lightly browned.
